contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN CONSTA-NS P F AVG ; R/ [FEL TEMP] REPARA[TIO]

An incomplete, Roman, copper-alloy nummus of Constantinus II (AD 323-361), dating to the period c. AD 348-350, (Reece period 18). FEL TEMP REPARATIO reverse type depicting Emperor standing left in a galley, Victory in the stern steering. Only 70% of the object survives. Obverse description: pearl diadem bust right. Obverse inscription: DN CONSTA-NS P F AVG. Reverse description: Emperor in a galley with a standard. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP] REPARA[TIO]. Diameter: 21.60 mm; Thickness: 2.14 mm; Weight: 3.48g die axis: 6
